subject.title: [Feature]: GitHub Copilot provider cannot reach GitHub Enterprise data-residency (*.ghe.com) tenants

question: Should the bundled `github-copilot` provider accept allowlisted `*.ghe.com` tenant routing, and what host validation and token-cache scoping must be required before merge?
rationale: The remaining decision is not whether current main is broken; it is whether this security-sensitive provider/auth expansion belongs in the bundled provider and whether the proposed host allowlist and cache/domain behavior are acceptable.

options.title: Approve bounded bundled-provider support
options.body: Land the linked PR after maintainer security review confirms the `github.com` plus single-label `*.ghe.com` allowlist, domain-scoped cache, and no-regression public GitHub behavior.

options.title: Route back to ClawHub/provider split
options.body: Reject bundled support and require an external provider/plugin path, accepting that current GitHub Copilot users on data-residency tenants remain blocked until that external path exists.

options.title: Defer for stronger enterprise proof
options.body: Keep the issue and PR open while asking for additional upgrade/security proof around domain switching, usage snapshots, and token reuse before choosing the product direction.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded bundled-provider support
recommendation.body: Land the linked PR after maintainer security review confirms the `github.com` plus single-label `*.ghe.com` allowlist, domain-scoped cache, and no-regression public GitHub behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The current provider/auth implementation history points to this person as the best code-history routing candidate for the bundled provider boundary decision.
